baseline: static initial source geometry, not dynamic destruction or runtime collision
coordinateSystem: map-aligned world metres; apply worldToMapPlaneFromBlender to Blender XY; world Z retained with original terrain scale
sourceNote: PC原始静态模型参考高度；未独立核验手游几何。 仅覆盖原生地形有效范围，边缘保留水平测距。
modelSampling: 1m cell-centre vertical triangle intersections, not exact collision at every pixel
caveats: Missing interior floors are not invented.
Tunnel openings/terrain holes are not reconstructed.
Near surface edges, use the height selector or manual ground-relative offset.
A model surface is not proof of walkability, visibility or collision.
